proposed_comments.title: Keep the generated gh-aw workflow versions in sync
proposed_comments.body:
### Keep the generated gh-aw workflow versions in sync

**Severity:** `high`

This Dependabot-only change updates the six `github/gh-aw-actions/setup` pins to v0.88.4, but the generated workflow still declares and caches gh-aw v0.87.10. Those artifacts are a matched generated bundle, so the next compile can restore the older action or fail against incompatible metadata. Please either restore all six setup pins to the existing v0.87.10 compiler/cache version, or regenerate the complete workflow with gh-aw v0.88.4 so the action pins, compiler metadata, and cache advance together.
